name: Ray-Ban
profile: A broad style vocabulary often associated with classic aviator, wayfarer and contemporary everyday shapes. Exact materials, lens options and features vary by model.

name: Oakley
profile: Performance-led design language and active-use styling. Confirm the exact model, fit, lens technology and intended use before purchase.

name: Vogue Eyewear
profile: Fashion-led shapes and seasonal styling. Frame construction, materials and finishes differ across collections.

name: Armani Exchange
profile: Modern, urban styling across optical and sun frames. Verify model-specific construction, dimensions and finish.

name: Tommy Hilfiger
profile: Everyday styling with a casual, classic design direction. Features and materials depend on the exact model.

name: Carrera
profile: Bold silhouettes and sport-influenced styling. Check model-specific fit, construction and lens details.

name: Titan Eye+
profile: A retail eyewear identity with collections across customer needs. Confirm the exact product range and availability locally.

name: Fastrack
profile: Casual, expressive styles across selected eyewear collections. Specifications vary by model.

name: John Jacobs
profile: Modern optical styling and varied frame silhouettes. Confirm materials, sizing and lens compatibility for each frame.

name: Lenskart Air
profile: Collection positioning emphasises lightweight styling; exact weight, material and construction should be checked against the model.

name: Essilor
profile: Lens brand and technology portfolio. Lens selection must be based on a valid prescription and a qualified professional's recommendation.

name: ZEISS
profile: Optical lens portfolio with model-specific coatings and design options. Confirm product name and technical specifications with the supplier.

name: HOYA
profile: Lens portfolio with different designs and treatments. Suitability depends on prescription, measurements and selected product.

name: Nikon Lenswear
profile: Lens options and treatments vary by product range and market. Confirm exact product specification before making claims.

name: Rodenstock
profile: Lens designs and options vary by product. A professional fitting and prescription review are important.
